learning_objective.text_en: Be able to complete and use two-way tables to record discrete data. Be able to create a two-way table from worded problems. (this can also be done using frequency tree diagrams).
learning_objective.text_zh: 能够完成和使用双向表记录离散数据。能够从文字问题中创建双向表（也可以使用频率树图完成）。
